PairingCode.title: PairingCode
PairingCode.description: Six-digit child pairing code generated by a child device so a parent device can link it.

childUid.description: Firebase UID of the child device session.

deviceLabel.description: Friendly device label shown to the parent.

parentUid.description: Firebase UID of the parent who claimed this code.

linkId.description: Created family_links document ID once claimed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when code was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when code was updated.

FamilyLink.title: FamilyLink
FamilyLink.description: Paired parent-child link holding live safety status, battery telemetry, and active transparent check-in requests.

memberUids.description: Denormalized array containing parentUid and childUid for rule-enforced queries.

childName.description: Child display nickname set by parent.

pairingCode.description: Six-digit code used to establish the link.

parentPin.description: Optional 4-digit parent PIN to lock role switching on the child phone.

activeRequestType.description: Current parent request awaiting or running on child device.

activeRequestAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest parent request.

childCharging.description: Whether the child device is currently charging.

childStatusText.description: Latest child status or activity note.

cameraSharingActive.description: Whether transparent camera check-in is currently active on child device.

screenSharingActive.description: Whether transparent screen sharing/recording is currently active on child device.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when link was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when link was updated.

FamilyMessage.title: FamilyMessage
FamilyMessage.description: Message or reminder exchanged between parent and child within a family link.

acknowledged.description: Whether the child acknowledged reading the message.

CheckinFrame.title: CheckinFrame
CheckinFrame.description: Compressed JPEG preview frame captured transparently during an authorized camera or screen check-in.

imageBase64.description: Compressed downscaled JPEG Base64 image data.

/family_links/{linkId}/messages/{message.description: Messages and alerts inside a family link.

/family_links/{linkId}/checkins/{checkin.description: Transparent camera and screen check-in frames inside a family link.
